extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, applicants, and USPTO examiners
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on the required parts, form, and content of U.S. patent applications (provisional and nonprovisional), including oaths/declarations, specification and drawing requirements, claim form, fees, and information disclosure procedures. Focused on USPTO/MPEP rules and procedural handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete applications (nonprovisional and provisional)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines what constitutes a complete provisional or nonprovisional application (e.g., required parts such as specification, claims where applicable, drawings, fees, oath/declaration or application data). See chapter for filing completeness consequences and processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion procedures between application types
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and requirements for converting between provisional and nonprovisional applications (timing, effects on priority/benefit claims, required documents and fees).

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling missing pages, claims, drawings, specifications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policies for addressing missing or incomplete parts of an application (e.g., how missing pages or omitted claims/drawings are treated, correction procedures, time limits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of attorney and correspondence address requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Power of attorney and correspondence address requirements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for submitting power of attorney, designation of correspondence address, signature requirements, and related change procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliographic information and application data sheets
rubrics_metrics.description: Bibliographic information and application data sheets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements and guidance for bibliographic data (inventor names, assignee, correspondence) and use/content of Application Data Sheets (ADS), including timing and corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oath or declaration: inventor naming and content
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for the content and execution of inventor oaths/declarations, who must sign, required statements, and acceptable formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of inventorship and inventor names
rubrics_metrics.description: Correction of inventorship and inventor names
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and standards for correcting inventorship or inventor name errors, including required affidavits/declarations, evidence, and impact on application status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign-executed oaths
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules governing oaths/declarations executed outside the United States (authentication, notarization, translation, and admissibility requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Oaths/declarations in continuing applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How oaths/declarations and related requirements carry forward or must be provided in continuing, divisional, or continuation-in-part applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint inventor identification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on identifying joint inventors, allocation of inventorship, and related declaration/oath requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental oath or declaration (post-allowance statements)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for filing supplemental oaths/declarations after allowance (e.g., to correct inventorship or supply missing statements), and their effect on issuance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substitute statements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When and how a substitute statement (e.g., when an inventor is unavailable) may be submitted in lieu of an inventor's oath/declaration, and procedural/formal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant identity requirements by filing date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules that vary by filing date regarding who may be the applicant (e.g., inventor vs. assignee), and any transitional or date-dependent requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title of invention and examiner authority to change
rubrics_metrics.description: Examiner authority to mandate title changes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for the title of the invention, when an examiner may require a change, and acceptable title format/content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing fee and fee returnability procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for payment of filing fees, conditions under which fees are returnable, procedures for refunds, and consequences of nonpayment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrangement of specification and abstract requirements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format and organizational requirements for the specification (e.g., arrangement of parts) and abstract content/length/format rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background and summary sections
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on content and purpose of the background of the invention and summary sections (what should be included/avoided, relationship to detailed description).

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawing descriptions and detailed description of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawing descriptions and detailed invention description
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for describing drawings and the detailed description (level of detail, reference numerals, enabling disclosure requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims: format, numbering, and statutory requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims format, numbering, and statutory requirements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for claim drafting including proper format, sequential numbering, statutory subject matter, definite language, antecedent basis, and formal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependent claim structures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules governing dependent claims (proper dependency, incorporation of limitations, multiple dependent claim restrictions, and proper referencing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification completeness standards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: What constitutes a complete specification (enablement, written description, best mode where applicable, and sufficiency of disclosure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Matter restoration and rewritten specifications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and limits for restoring inadvertently omitted matter or submitting a rewritten specification, including when rewriting is permitted and required formality checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings: acceptability and replacement procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for acceptable drawings (format, clarity, labels) and procedures for replacing or correcting drawings after filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings: completeness and consistency standards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements that drawings be complete and consistent with the specification and claims (all elements shown when necessary, consistency of reference numerals and figures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings: modification and correction protocols
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How and when drawings may be modified or corrected (e.g., by amendment, affidavit/statement, or correction practice) and limits on substantive changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figure cancellation procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for canceling figures (e.g., removing redundant or improper figures) and documentation required to show cancellation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Models, exhibits, and specimens handling
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for submission, inspection, retention, and use of physical models, exhibits, and specimens in support of an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: New matter restrictions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibition against introducing new matter into the specification/claims after filing and procedures for determining whether an amendment adds new matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listings, large tables, and computer program appendices
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequence listings, large tables, and computer program appendices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special requirements and formats for submitting sequence listings, oversized tables, and computer program appendices (e.g., file formats, itemization, and incorporation by reference rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Disclosure Statement: content and timing requirements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: What must be included in an IDS, when it must be filed, time windows for submission, and any required certifications or statements regarding relevance and materiality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Disclosure Statement: examiner handling procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How examiners process IDS filings, evaluation of cited documents, and the effect of IDS on prosecution (e.g., consideration, entry criteria).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Disclosure Statement: electronic submission protocols
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements and instructions for electronic submission of IDS and supporting documents (acceptable formats, e-filing procedures, and declarations).
